# Casberi

> Keep it moving, privately. Your life and money are spread across accounts; you spend the day switching between apps to get anything done. Casberi gives you an inbox and a wallet to keep it all moving, privately: keep up with your feeds and finances in one place. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with no Casberi account, and read on your device.

Key facts:

- Free on the App Store for iPhone, iPad and Mac.
- More than 100 apps connect, among them Gmail, iCloud Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Photos, Apple Health, Apple Wallet, GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira, Notion, Slack, Trello, Stripe, Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS, App Store Connect, Readwise, RSS, Substack, YouTube, Spotify, Bluesky, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, Telegram, Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and Gemini.
- Three places and one act: Feed is what's happening, Wallet is what you have, Library is your apps and you, and Move, the circle beside them, is what you do with your money. Search is Library's field. On the Mac they run down a rail.
- Feed: every app together, in seven sections — Day, Notes, Social, Work, Media, Life and Agents — each holding today's rows, one row per app. Tap a section for the whole category, or an app for that app alone.
- Wallet: one balance across self-custody accounts (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, World Chain, HyperEVM, Monad, Robinhood Chain, Tempo, Solana and Bitcoin), Coinbase, Kraken, Binance and Gemini, ETH validators, and Wise and Apple Wallet cash. Its pages: Home (your balance, then Account, Needs you, Permissions and Threats), Activity, Holdings and Spending (subscriptions, places, fees and round-ups). Following an account is read-only: you paste an address or a name, never a seed phrase, and it can never move funds.
- Move: an account of your own in three parts — a public account (a Safe on Base, Ethereum and Robinhood Chain, no seed phrase), a private balance (0xBow Privacy Pools and Railgun on Ethereum, picked by the token) and a private account (Aztec, for private apps and payments, proved on the iPhone) — and five verbs, each approved with Face ID: Buy a gift card, Receive, Send, Swap and Sweep. Swaps go straight to Uniswap and Aerodrome from the phone, through Tor; a swap to another network crosses through Across. Sweep turns every token under $1 or $5 on a network into ETH in one transaction. Sends, swaps and gift cards can round up, the change buying a token you pick.
- Library: a search field over Casberi's settings and every app you have, by category. Contacts (in Social) and Calendar (in Day) open their own pages; the Wallet folder starts with Aztec's directory.
- Subscriptions are found on their own from your cards, Apple Wallet and Rocket Money; what they cost lives in the Wallet's Spending.
- Testnets: the Logos testnet, with test coins only.
- Agents: read what the agents you use did, in one place. Ask Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others with your own key, kept in the Keychain and sent from the device straight to that provider; your own OpenAI-compatible server; or Apple Intelligence with no key.
- Notes and voice notes, Contacts across your accounts, and share cards. Widgets for your notes, your wallet and your feed.
- No Casberi account, no server, no analytics. Every request that names a wallet goes through Tor on iPhone and iPad. iCloud sync is opt-in. Export, import and delete-everything are real controls.
